name: synthetic-query-refused
description: SYNTHETIC. Shape taken from the live contract (GET /contract, apiVersion 2.1.2, contract_hash 08f0406173520512). IDs and records are invented placeholders, not real people. Replace via `deno task record` once METIX_CREDENTIALS_API_KEY exists. Recorded shape of a real 400 query refusal (2026-10-09, an operator the field does not accept), body verbatim apart from the trace id. A query is translated before anything is charged, so a refusal costs nothing. `docs_url` is fetchable as markdown by adding .md ahead of the fragment, which is how an agent recovers.

body.msg: Unsupported operator. Operators are eq, in, match, gte, gt, lte, lt and exists; GET /contract lists the ones each field takes (querySpecByEntity, fieldOperators).
